integrity.evidence_limit: Exact algebra plus a written uniform sign argument; no claim of external certification.
integrity.reproducibility: The quotient determinant, all orbit formulas and the remainder identity are symbolically checked by the included exact-arithmetic program; direct rational cases are also checked.

scientific_limitations: Only one anomalous spoke; other spoke conductances are normalized to one.
Completed two-stage Gauss-Legendre step only; no assertion about internal stage positivity.
Finite exact matrix tests support but do not replace a proof for all orders and real parameters.
An apparently related 2013 book chapter was not available in full text; historical coverage cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Exact positivity horizons for fourth-order Gauss diffusion on a star with one anomalous spoke
